sections.heading: Compare configuration and model limits
sections.reader_question: Which configuration should enter the shortlist?
sections.limitation: Fixture clearance and dynamic loads remain unassessed.
sections.procurement_action: Send the fixture layout for configuration review.

sections.heading: Read spindle and cutting trial evidence
sections.reader_question: What do spindle ratings establish under the recorded conditions?
sections.procurement_action: Request a representative loaded trial and torque records.

sections.heading: Machine and application fit
sections.reader_question: Does the supplied trial represent the intended material and cycle?
sections.limitation: Other applications require new representative trials.
sections.procurement_action: Submit the intended material, drawing and complete cycle.

sections.heading: Specify representative acceptance tests
sections.reader_question: What do measured results establish for acceptance?
sections.limitation: The samples do not establish production capability.
sections.procurement_action: Agree a representative measurement and uncertainty procedure.

sections.heading: Procurement and acceptance
sections.reader_question: What needs agreement before the purchase order?
sections.procurement_action: Send the RFQ fields and negotiate acceptance responsibilities.

sections.heading: Agree delivery training and support
sections.reader_question: What delivery and support terms apply to the quoted configuration?
sections.limitation: The proposals are not signed commitments.
sections.procurement_action: Confirm the configuration register and commercial terms in writing.
